name: RIACO Autocomplete Orders for WooCommerce
author: robertoiacono

sections.description:
RIACO Autocomplete Orders for WooCommerce helps store owners streamline order management by automatically completing WooCommerce orders based on specific product types and order statuses.

Perfect for stores that sell virtual, downloadable, or digital products — no manual status updates required.

Features

  • Autocomplete orders when all products are:
    • Virtual
    • Downloadable
    • Or specific product types (configurable)
  • Choose which WooCommerce order statuses should trigger the check.
  • Lightweight, fast, and hooks seamlessly into WooCommerce order lifecycle.
  • Built with extensibility in mind (actions & filters available).
  • Developer-friendly and ready for extension via a premium version.

Use Cases

  • You sell eBooks or online courses and want orders to be marked “Completed” automatically.
  • You want only certain order statuses (e.g., “processing” or “on-hold”) to trigger auto-complete.
  • You want to reduce support tickets from customers asking where their download is.

Roadmap

  • Premium version with extended conditions

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/riaco-autocomplete-orders directory, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Autocomplete Orders to configure options.
sections.faq:
Can I autocomplete only specific product types?

Yes. You can configure which product types should allow automatic completion. The plugin will autocomplete an order only if all products in the order match one of the allowed types.

Will this complete physical product orders?

No. Unless all products in the order meet the type criteria, the order will not be marked as completed.

Does this plugin work with all payment gateways?

Yes, the plugin is gateway-agnostic. However, you should only enable autocomplete on statuses that are safe (e.g., after payment is complete).
